collection.description: A child asks why a frightening event happened to someone kind, and adults cannot offer a satisfying explanation.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why a frightening event happened to someone kind, and adults cannot offer a satisfying explanation.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) learns that bad things can happen without anyone deserving them.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They ask for reassurance about who will care for them.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) chooses to sit quietly with (adult), a caregiver.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) returns with another question days later.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (adult) promises to listen without pretending every mystery is solved.
